title: Stable Matching
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: STABLE MATCHING SAVE01
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Increasing lines; common pointer base 17125; exact end marker/EOF; byte-identical left/right payload
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
2 P=979
10 CLEAR 2000
50 INPUT "HOW MANY MEN (MUST BE AN EQUAL # OF MEN & WOMEN)";N
80 DIM P(N,N,1),N$(N,1)
100 FOR L=0 TO1:FOR I=1 TO N
105 CLS
110 READ N$(I,L)
115 FOR J=1 TO N
120 PRINT"I WANT ";
125 IF L THEN PRINT"WOMEN #"; ELSE PRINT "MAN #";
130 PRINT I;"'S PREFERENCE FOR ";:IF L THEN PRINT"MAN #"; ELSE PRINT"WOMAN #";
135 PRINT J;":":READ P(I,J,L)
